definitions: A dish of cooked meat cut into small pieces and reheated, usually with potatoes.
A mixture or jumble of things.
The symbol #, also known as a hash mark or number sign.
A value returned by a hash function in computing.
examples: A breakfast of corned beef hash.
He made a complete hash of the presentation.
Please enter your password followed by the hash.
The algorithm generates a unique hash for each file.
